info.description: A video production pipeline API. It does not speed up any generation model's rendering; it removes the waiting around generation: right-sized generation durations computed in code from a timing map, automatic DriftCheck gating (drift + frozen spans) the moment a clip lands, corrected-prompt re-queueing for failed clips, and automatic assembly of passing clips against the job's audio track with a measured report. The import adapter (clips generated in any lane) is live; the Replicate (Seedance) adapter activates with the caller's own token.
info.title: SwiftRender

get.summary: Engine and adapter states (open, no gate)

201.description: Job created; the record shows the per-line duration computation and the right-sized totals vs the flat 10 s default

422.description: Bad timing map or audio fetch failure

post.summary: Create a production job from a timing map

get.summary: Full job status: timing math, imports with gate reports, retry queue, missing lines, assembly report

200.description: Assembly report (per-line spans, durations, loudness, frozen spans, decode check) and output_url

post.summary: Assemble all passing clips per the timing map against the job's audio. Refuses with the missing lines listed until every line passes

prompt.description: Defaults to the line's corrected prompt from its last failure, else its job prompt

post.summary: Generate a line through a provider adapter (default: replicate). Answers 503 provider_not_configured until the Replicate token is provided; the import adapter is the live generation route meanwhile

200.description: Gate verdict (pass/warn install the clip; fail returns failure_class and a corrected prompt and installs nothing)

post.summary: Import a clip generated in any lane (multipart video part named 'video'); it is gated automatically on arrival. Optional fields: approved_in_s (assembly in-point), visual_failure (caller-attested visual QA failure class: frozen, composition_replacement, text_artifact, general_drift)
